jd:
The Role

Babbage is a fictional company used for this fixture. It runs human-expert data projects that AI research teams use to train, post-train, and evaluate models. The Strategic Project Lead owns delivery on those projects, from customer kickoff to final dataset, coordinating large pools of contributors and keeping the customer relationship healthy.

What You'll Do

1) Operational execution

Design and run the pipeline from customer specification to delivered dataset, with accountability for scope, timeline, and quality.
Find bottlenecks as they form: re-sequence work, sharpen instructions, adjust incentives, and scale review to hit throughput targets.

2) Customer relationships

Serve as the main point of contact for the researchers and program managers on each account.
Report clearly and on a fixed cadence, and anticipate what the customer will need next.

3) Large-scale coordination

Recruit, vet, onboard, train, and performance-manage domain experts across distributed teams of 100 to 1,000 or more contributors.
Hold execution standards at every production stage, from annotation through review to delivery.

4) Quality ownership

Own quality control across the annotation lifecycle: set the bar, measure against it, and close the gap when it slips.
Analyze delivered data for trends, anomalies, and systematic errors, and fix root causes.

5) Process improvement and playbooks

Make each delivery cycle faster and cheaper than the last, and document what works so the next lead ramps faster.

Who We're Looking For

A background in consulting, finance, startups, or another operationally intense setting, with a record of running complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong analytical and communication skills: you can spot a bottleneck in a noisy production line, measure it, and explain the fix to a demanding customer in plain language.
Customer-facing experience with senior technical stakeholders.

Locations: New York and San Francisco.
